WikiOasisMagicAccessIdsMap.description: Array. Map of wiki database names to an array of CentralAuth user IDs which are allowed to read that wiki. Users not in the list have the read right removed.

WikiOasisMagicMemcachedServers.description: Array. Memcached servers to use for clearing memcached keys when a wiki is deleted or renamed.

WikiOasisMagicReportsBlockAlertKeywords.description: Array. Words in block reasons which trigger a report being sent to TSPortal.

WikiOasisMagicReportsWriteKey.description: String. TSPortal write key to be used when connecting to it.

WikiOasisMagicCloudflareAPIToken.description: Cloudflare API Token used for cache purging.

WikiOasisMagicCloudflareZoneID.description: Cloudflare Zone ID for this wiki's domain.

WikiOasisMagicEnableNewOnboarding.description: Bool. The new signup screen, the redirect to Special:Welcome after signup and their metrics on this wiki. Wiki experiments can switch it for a share of wikis.

WikiOasisMagicCentralWiki.description: String|null. Database name of the central wiki (Meta): where experiments are managed, what "@central" matches and where wikis are requested. Null asks CreateWiki.

WikiOasisMagicExperiments.description: Array. Experiments keyed by name; see includes/Experiments/Experiment.php for the format and README.md for examples. Their rollout is managed on Special:Experiments.

WikiOasisMagicExperimentsDashboardUrl.description: String. Grafana dashboard linked from Special:Experiments; "{experiment}" is replaced by the experiment name.

WikiOasisMagicExperimentsHashSecret.description: String. Key for the HMAC that stores users and browsers in the experiment tables. Must be the same on every wiki; changing it detaches what was stored. Empty uses $wgSecretKey.

WikiOasisMagicExperimentsRetentionDays.description: Int. How many days PruneExperimentData keeps a unit after it was last seen or last did something, and daily counts.

WikiOasisMagicOnboardingSurveys.description: Array. Survey definitions keyed by name. 'central' is used on the central wiki and 'local' everywhere else, unless an experiment variant names another survey or the wiki has a valid MediaWiki:WikiOasisOnboarding.json. See includes/Onboarding/SurveyValidator.php for the format. Options with action 'createwiki' or 'importwiki' are dropped outside the central wiki.

WikiOasisMagicOnboardingAllowLocalSurvey.description: Bool. Whether MediaWiki:WikiOasisOnboarding.json may replace this wiki's survey.

WikiOasisMagicOnboardingAttributionDays.description: Int. For how many days after registering a user's edits and wiki requests are counted as conversions for the variant they were assigned.

WikiOasisMagicOnboardingDirectoryUrl.description: String. URL of a directory of wikis. Used while requesting a wiki and by survey cards whose url starts with {directory}; those cards are hidden when this is empty.

WikiOasisMagicFandomImportEnabled.description: Bool. Special:FandomImport on the central wiki. Needs the wo_fandom_import table there and the import worker (salt: fandom_import) on the job runner host.

WikiOasisMagicFandomImportSpoolDir.description: String. Directory shared with the Fandom import worker on the job runner host; jobs write to its queue/ subdirectory.

WikiOasisMagicFandomImportLargeFileCount.description: Int. Imports of Fandom wikis with at least this many files must be confirmed by the reviewer: copying them takes days.

WikiOasisMagicFandomImportUploadUser.description: String. The system account that imported files are uploaded as on the new wiki.

WikiOasisMagicFandomImportUsernamePrefix.description: String. Interwiki prefix for the authors of imported edits, as in importDump.php --username-prefix. Matches ImportDump's prefix for fandom.com.

WikiOasisMagicFandomImportPreferFullHist.description: Bool. Import the Fandom dump with every revision when it can be downloaded, rather than only the current ones.

WikiOasisMagicFandomImportExtensionMap.description: Array. Extensions on a Fandom wiki (by name, as its siteinfo lists them) mapped to the ManageWiki extension turned on for the new wiki.
